jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Infrastructure

location.name: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States

jobs.content: &lt;p&gt;The mission of the Engineering TPM team is to drive Figma's most important cross-company engineering efforts, and we are looking for a Technical Program Manager to partner with our Infrastructure team. The TPM provides oversight of efforts that require coordinated technical execution across the organization.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;What you'll do at Figma&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;Lead the execution, coordination, and risk management of Figma's infrastructure projects, ensuring seamless integration with minimal performance impact.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Drive key infrastructure initiatives, including reliability, storage, distributed systems, cloud-native performance improvements, and compliance programs including FedRAMP and SOC 2.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Partner closely with engineering, security, compliance, and legal teams to ensure alignment and on-time delivery.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Track program milestones and delivery across multiple infrastructure teams, including data, caching, observability, and security engineering.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Provide regular updates to executive leadership on risks, blockers, and dependencies.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;h3&gt;We'd love to hear from you if you have&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;8+ years in Infrastructure TPM or related roles with hands-on experience in cloud-native architectures and distributed systems such as AWS or GCP.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Deep technical expertise across infrastructure components including storage, caching, search, and event-driven systems such as Kafka.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Track record driving large-scale infrastructure programs such as migrations, cost optimization, encryption key management, and reliability initiatives for high-availability services.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Strong cross-functional program management skills coordinating multi-team engineering organizations and establishing program management best practices in ambiguous environments.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Proven stakeholder management translating complex technical challenges into clear executive-level communications.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;
